About me

I’m Ezra — a curious student who enjoys learning, building, and trying new things.

My name is Ezra, and I was born in 2015. I am both Korean and Australian, and I enjoy learning in many different ways.

I enjoy coding because I like the feeling of starting with an idea and seeing it work. I also like reading, and I can read about two thick books in a day when I really get into them. I like running, basketball, piano, ballet, Chinese, and I also enjoy Minecraft and LEGO.
